title: ICS Decoder Integration - SEOS SIO Credential Cloning
body:
## Summary

Integrates ICS Decoder bridge support for reading SEOS SIO credentials and cloning to legacy iClass/Picopass or T5577 blanks.

## Features

- **SEOS SIO Credential Extraction**: Read SEOS/SE cards via USB ICS Decoder dongle
- **Dual-Frequency Support**: Write to iClass Legacy (HF 13.56 MHz) or T5577 (LF 125 kHz)
- **Auto-Detection**: Automatically detects target blank type on PM3 coil
- **Post-Write Verification**: Confirms data integrity after writing
- **NN Right-Shift Parsing**: Extracts Wiegand credentials from SIO PACS payloads
- **Multi-Key Support**: Handles both HID iClass keys and virgin Picopass transport keys

## Working Configurations

- 48-bit SEOS cards -> iClass Legacy/Picopass
- 26-bit SEOS cards -> T5577
- 26-bit SEOS cards -> iClass Legacy/Picopass

## Hardware Requirements

- DIY ICS Decoder (tested): https://github.com/Dysonian-Lab/icopy-x-ics-decoder
- Nikola ICS Decoder (testing pending)

## Testing

Tested on iCopy-XS with:
- 48-bit SEOS cards -> iClass Legacy write/verify
- 26-bit SEOS cards -> T5577 write/verify
- Navigation and exit (gray screen bug fixed)
